name: Restaurant Inventory Auto-Order
description: Runs on a nightly schedule to query current inventory levels from the restaurant's database, filters for items that have dropped below their reorder threshold, loops through each low-stock item to build purchase order line items from a supplier template, routes the order through a manager approval gate, emails the finalized purchase order to the supplier, and updates the inventory records to reflect the pending restock. Designed for restaurants and hospitality businesses that need automated supply chain management to prevent stockouts during peak service.

data.label: Run nightly at 11 PM after service

config.query: SELECT i.id, i.item_name, i.current_quantity, i.unit, i.reorder_threshold, i.reorder_quantity, i.category, s.supplier_name, s.email AS supplier_email, s.lead_time_days FROM inventory i JOIN suppliers s ON i.preferred_supplier_id = s.id WHERE i.current_quantity <= i.reorder_threshold AND i.is_active = true ORDER BY i.category, i.item_name

data.label: Filter items not already on pending order

config.condition: item.pending_order_id IS NULL AND item.current_quantity <= item.reorder_threshold

operation.expression: { lineNumber: idx + 1, itemId: item.id, itemName: item.item_name, quantity: item.reorder_quantity, unit: item.unit, category: item.category, supplierName: item.supplier_name, supplierEmail: item.supplier_email, estimatedDelivery: addDays(now(), item.lead_time_days) }

config.template:
Purchase Order - {{formatDate(now(), 'YYYY-MM-DD')}}

Restaurant: {{env.RESTAURANT_NAME}}

Order Date: {{formatDate(now(), 'MMMM D, YYYY')}}

{{#each orderLines}}{{/each}}
#ItemQuantityUnitCategoryEst. Delivery
{{this.lineNumber}}{{this.itemName}}{{this.quantity}}{{this.unit}}{{this.category}}{{formatDate(this.estimatedDelivery, 'MMM D')}}

Total Items: {{orderLines.length}}

config.message:
Review the auto-generated purchase order for {{orderLines.length}} items below reorder threshold.

Items include: {{orderLines | map('itemName') | join(', ')}}

data.label: Update inventory with pending order status

config.query: UPDATE inventory SET pending_order_id = $1, pending_order_date = NOW(), last_reorder_date = NOW() WHERE id = ANY($2) RETURNING id, item_name, pending_order_id
